request.style: English, spoken word poetry, a young male voice speaking over a slow hip hop beat with felt piano and strings, a female voice singing the refrain, honest and searching, 76 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Lord, you have searched me and known me
You know when I sit down and when I rise
You discern my thoughts from far away
Before a word is on my tongue
You know it altogether

[Chorus]
You knit me together in my mother's womb
I am fearfully and wonderfully made

[Verse]
Where shall I go from your Spirit
Where shall I flee from your presence
If I ascend to heaven, you are there
If I make my bed in the depths, you are there
Even the darkness is not dark to you

[Chorus]
You knit me together in my mother's womb
I am fearfully and wonderfully made

[Outro]
Search me, O God, and know my heart
